questions.question: A boy walked along two adjacent sides of a rectangular field. If he had walked along the diagonal, then he would have saved a distance equal to one-fourth of the larger side. The ratio of the smaller to the larger side is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A rectangular field with Length, breadth and diagonal. 

**Formula used:**

Pythagoras Theorem

Base² + Perpendicular² = Hypotenuse²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43e342a723233fd683222e4ffe34eabf532362caea6d78de250947e60e0494f3.png] 

Let the Length of the rectangular field = l

⇒ Breadth of the field = b

⇒ Diagonal of the field = d 

Letting that l > b

In triangle right-angle triangle ABC. By using Pythagoras Theorem we have:

l² + b² = d² ......(1)

l + b - d = 1/4 × l 

⇒ l + b - l/4 = d

⇒ 3l/4 + b = d .....(2)

Putting the value of d in equation (1), we get:

l2 + b2 = ( 3l/4 + b)²

⇒ l2 + b2 = 9l²/16 + b² + 2 × 3l/4 × b 

⇒ l2 - 9l2/16 = 3lb/2 

⇒7l/8 = 3b 

⇒ l/b = 3 × 8/7

⇒ b/l = 7/24

**∴ The required ratio between the smaller side and the larger side is 7 : 24.**

questions.question: In a class of 80 students, 60% are girls and the rest are boys. The average weight of boys is 5% more than that of girls. If the average weight of all the students is 51 kg, then what is the average weight (in kg) of the girls?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Girls : Boys = 60% : 40% = 3 : 2.

Let Average weight of Girls = 20 units, then Boys = 21 units (5% more than 20).

Total Weighted Average = [(3 × 20) + (2 × 21)] ÷ 5 = 102 ÷ 5 = 20.4 units.

20.4 units = 51 kg ⇒ 1 unit = 2.5 kg.

Average weight of Girls = 20 units × 2.5 = 50 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total students = 80, Girls = 60%, Average of all = 51 kg, Boys avg = 5% more than girls.

**Formula Used:** Weighted Average = (n₁ × x₁ + n₂ × x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 
• 
 
 Girls (3 Parts)
 Weight: x
 
 Boys (2 Parts)
 Weight: 1.05x
 

 Mean = 51 kg
 Weighted Average Representation

⇒ Number of Girls = 60% of 80 = 48; Number of Boys = 40% of 80 = 32.

⇒ Ratio of Girls : Boys = 48 : 32 = 3 : 2.

⇒ Let average weight of girls = x kg.

⇒ Average weight of boys = x + 5% of x = 1.05x kg.

⇒ Total Average = (3 × x + 2 × 1.05x) ÷ (3 + 2)

⇒ 51 = (3x + 2.1x) ÷ 5

⇒ 51 × 5 = 5.1x

⇒ 255 = 5.1x

⇒ x = 255 ÷ 5.1 = 50 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Concept

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Percentage Increase in Average

If an average weight 'x' increases by 'k%', the new average is x × (1 + k/100).

Ratio Method for Averages

Using the ratio of the number of items (3:2 instead of 48:32) simplifies calculations significantly in weighted average problems.</p

questions.question: If 4 men can reap a field in 5 days working 9 hours a day, in how many hours can 10 men reap the same field working 3 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by 4 men working 9 hours a day = 5 days

**Formula used:**

(M1 × D1 × H1)/W1 = (M2 × D2 × H2)/W2

**Calculation:**

(4 × 5 × 9)/1 = (10 × 3 × H2)/1 

⇒ H2 = (4 × 5 × 9)/(10 × 3)

⇒ H2 = 6 

**∴ The required number of hours is 6.**

questions.question: A train takes 1 hour 30 minutes to travel between two stations P and Q. If it travels at (5)/(6) of its usual speed, how long will it take to travel between P and Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by the train to travel from P and Q = 1 hour 30 minutes 

**Formula used:**

Distance/Speed = Time 

When the distance is constant, Time = 1/speed 

**Calculation:**

Let the usual speed be = 6 units

⇒ Reduced speed = 6 × 5/6 = 5 units

Time taken by the train with usual speed = 1 hour 30 minutes 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fc62a722eb08edc4e2ea907b7dc8bcbc8ac14e07c36292e3d2f64feadcead9b.png] 

So, 5 = 3/2 hours 

⇒ 6 = 3/2 × 6/5 

⇒ 6 = 1 hour 48 minutes 

**∴ Time taken to travel from P to Q with reduced speed is 1 hour 48 minutes.**

questions.question: What is the sum of the numbers between 300 and 400 such that when they are divided by 6, 12 and 16, it leaves no remainder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers between 300 and 400. 

**Formula used:**

HCF: Product of the smallest power of each common prime factor in the numbers.

LCM: Product of the greatest power of each prime factor, involved in the numbers.

**Calculation:**

By Prime Factorization:

6 = 2 × 3 

12 = 2² × 3

16 = 2⁴

LCM of 6, 12 and 16 = 24 × 3 = 48

Multiples of 48 between 300 and 400 which are: 336, 384

∴ The required sum = 336 + 384 

**⇒ 720**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 29,282 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when the interest is compounded yearly. What is the simple interest (in Rs.) on double of the sum for five years’ time at the same rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount in 4 years at 10% per annum = Rs.29282 

**Formulas used:**

Amount on compound interest (compounded yearly)

P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Simple Interest = P × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

Rs.29282 = P × (1 + 10/100)⁴

⇒ 29282 = P × 14641/10000 

⇒ P = 29282 × 10000/14641 

⇒ P = 20000 

Simple interest at double the sum for 5 years at 10% p.a:

⇒ 2 × 20000 × 5 × 10/100 

⇒ 20000

**∴ The required simple interest is Rs.20000. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Amount for 10% interest = 10 + 1 = 11 units

The total amount for 4 years

⇒ 11 × 11 × 11 × 11 = 14641 units = Rs. 29282

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 2

Principal = 10 × 10 × 10 × 10 = 10000 units 

Principal = Rs. 2 × 100000 = Rs. 20000

Interest = (20000 × 2 × 5 × 10)/100 = Rs. 20000

∴ The interest is Rs. 20000.

questions.question: A person borrows Rs. 75,000 for 3 years at 7% simple interest. He lends it to B at 5% for 3 years. What is his loss (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal borrowed for 3 years at 7% simple interest = Rs.75000 

Lending rate of the same principal for 3 years = 5% 

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

Simple interest payable = 75000 × 7/100 × 3 

⇒ Rs.15750 

Simple interest Receivable = 75000 × 5/100 × 3 

⇒ Rs.11250

∴ Loss incurred by the person = Interest payable - Interest receivable 

**⇒ Rs.15750 - 11250 = Rs.4500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Loss = 75000 × (7 - 5)% × 3 

⇒ 75000 × 2/100 × 3 

**⇒ Rs.4500 **

questions.question: ‘A’ is 3 times as good a workman as 'B’ and therefore is able to complete a job in 36 days less than ‘B’. In how many days will they finish 40% of the work, working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 3 : 1

Time difference to be taken by A and B = 36 days

**Concepts used:**

Time = 1/Efficiency

Total Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 3 : 1

⇒ Ratio of time taken by A and B = 1 : 3

Let the time taken by A and B be y and 3y. 

As per the question, 

Time difference by B and A = 36 days 

3y - y = 36

⇒ 2y = 36 

⇒ y = 18 days 

Now, B can complete the whole work in = 3y = 54 days 

A can complete the whole work in = 18 days 

Total work done by A = 3 × 18 = 54 units

⇒ 40% of the work = 54 × 40/100 = 108/5

∴ Time taken by A and B to do 40% of the work together = (108/5)/(3 + 1)

**⇒ 5(2)/(5) days **

questions.question: The selling price of an article is Rs. 2,300 and profit percentage is 25%. If the article is sold again for Rs.1,656, then what is the loss/gain percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price 1 = Rs.2300 

Profit percentage = 25%

Selling Price 2 = Rs.1656 

**Formulas used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price × (100 + Profit)%

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price

Loss Percentage = Loss/Cost Price × 100 

**Calculation:**

Cost Price = 2300 × 100%/(100 + 25)%

⇒ Rs.1840 

Loss = Rs.1840 - Rs.1656 = Rs.184 

**∴ Loss percentage = 184/1840 × 100 **

**⇒ 10%**

Inverse proportion

**Calculation:**

Price per kg after reduction = 100a × 80% = 80a 

800/80a - 800/100a = 5

⇒ 10/a - 8/a = 5
